channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Yemen’s army says recaptured key territory as clashes with Houthis continue
item.description: Two days of fighting between government forces and Houthi fighters has left dozens dead on both sides, sources say.

item.title: Russian drone strikes Ukraine’s security service headquarters
item.description: A Russian drone has struck Ukraine’s domestic intelligence headquarters in central Kyiv, injuring five people.

item.title: Diesel price hits all-time high in US amid Iran war woes
item.description: Price of gasoline also sets new record for Labor Day weekend ahead of crucial midterm elections in November.

item.title: Philippine court orders arrest of VP Duterte over President Marcos threats
item.description: Warrant follows charge she threatened to have Marcos, his wife and a cousin killed by a hitman.

item.title: Steve Irwin's family celebrates 'superhero' dad, 20 years after shock death
item.description: The Australian icon was killed in 2006, after a stingray's barb pierced his chest during filming.

item.title: US diesel prices hit an all-time-high
item.description: Fuel prices have soared since the Iran conflict began at the end of February, mirroring the surge in wholesale oil prices.

item.title: US investigating if missile hit Iran wedding, Vance says
item.description: The Iranian Red Crescent Society (IRCS) said shrapnel from a missile hit the ceremony and killed four people on Tuesday.

item.title: How could US-Iran conflict end? Three experts give their views
item.description: After renewed strikes this week, does either side have an exit strategy?

item.title: 'The crowd shouted that we'd stolen someone's genitals' - deadly rumours spread on social media
item.description: More than 80 people have been killed in the mob violence, the BBC finds after gathering data from six African nations.

item.title: 'We expect our sons to be killed,' father of teen shot dead in West Bank tells BBC
item.description: Palestinian teenagers Omar al-Naasan and Khalil Abu Alia were shot dead when Israeli settlers and soldiers entered a village in the occupied West Bank.
